sloka: न त्वेव सीताम् परमाभिजाताम् ।पथि स्थिते राजकुले प्रजाताम् ।लताम् प्रपुल्लामिव साधु जाताम् ।ददर्श तन्वीम् मनसाभिजाताम् ॥५-५-२३॥
transliteration: na tveva sītām paramābhijātām ।pathi sthite rājakule prajātām ।latām prapullāmiva sādhu jātām ।dadarśa tanvīm manasābhijātām ॥5-5-23॥

translations.english: Hanuman could not find Sita anywhere, an excellent lady born in a noble royal family, adopting the right path, a lady delicate like a blossoming creeper of good breed, or so he imagined.
